This system authenticates users via a primary device's graphical user interface, facilitating seamless interaction and control during virtual and hybrid events. These innovations aim to improve the immersive attendee experience central to Airmeet's platform.

about_short_description.short_description: Airmeet is an all-in-one platform for virtual & hybrid summits, conferences, and events designed for an immersive attendee experience.

product.name: Airmeet Event Experience Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based platform for hosting virtual and hybrid events including webinars, conferences, and workshops with interactive features and attendee engagement tools.

product.name: Airmeet Managed Events
product.description: A service offering where Airmeet provides end-to-end event production and management support for virtual and hybrid events.

product.name: Airmeet Integrations
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Airmeet with over 50 third-party applications including CRM systems like HubSpot for real-time data syncing and attendee tracking.

product.name: Airmeet Engagement & Networking Features
product.description: Interactive tools within Airmeet that support attendee engagement such as breakout rooms, speed networking, live polls, Q&A, and gamification elements.

product.name: Airmeet Branding & Customization
product.description: Capabilities that allow event organizers to customize event appearance and branding, including AI-driven branding tools and tailored landing pages.
